title: Administrator access choices
decision: A person is an administrator only if their Telegram identifier is in the server's allow-list and an active account row exists; anyone else gets the same not-found answer as for an unknown address; five wrong codes lock the second factor for 15 minutes and end the session; a lost device is replaced by an operator on the server, not through the API; tables admin_audit, admin_session and admin_request_key and four cross-tenant functions were added beyond the approved schema; a dependency on the cryptography package was added; the owner of a suspended shop is told the reason the administrator wrote; a setting stored outside its range is ignored in favour of the default
context: Decided by an agent during the autonomous build under DEC-020; implemented and awaiting the founder's review
chosen_option: Choices as listed in pull request 42
rationale: ADR-017 asks for an allow-list and a second factor and leaves the lock-out, recovery and storage open
